claim_boundary: A very small COCO pre-dataset with body-part, point, scoreboard, strip, and weapon annotations. Multiple frames sharing a filename family are one source group. The COCO export embeds an MIT label, but the repository has no top-level license and does not document the footage provenance, so images and row-level derivatives remain local. Eight images cannot establish a general segmentation benchmark.
rights_status: COCO export says MIT; repository and source-footage rights are undocumented
